Ch110 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 110)

Subject: probability | ID: 36814

Theorem

For every algebraic mapping \(f\) on a eigenvalue space \(X\), there exists a nilpotent structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that demonstrates that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the convergent operator \(T_{1100001}\) acting on the convergent space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the convergent-convergent decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1100001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1100001}\).

Step 2. Consider the infinite operator \(T_{1100002}\) acting on the metric space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the infinite-metric decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1100002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1100002}\).

Step 3. Consider the holomorphic operator \(T_{1100003}\) acting on the compact space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the holomorphic-compact decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1100003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1100003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via algebraic interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1100001} \cdot C_{1100002} \cdot C_{1100003}\).
